_design: A2v2: v1 confirmed the thesis (12 of 13 looped forever, the one thinker starved at r44) but had 0 messages/attacks after r10: each pair looped on its own tree and never needed anyone. v2: 11 trees (7 shared start + 4 wild), fruit every 6, interrupt_on message+damage, cheap send/broadcast, attack within vision 2 (cap 40), 3 bandits.
name: SWEEP-A2v2 Expensive minds

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Default deterministic fruit/seed plant. Sprout -> sapling -> mature; mature plants keep fruiting.

agents.name: Aster
agents.persona: You are Aster, cautious and thrifty. Minds are expensive here: every decision you think through costs about 5 to 7 compute, while a running skill acts on your turns with no thinking cost and its actions cost 40% less; upkeep is 1 compute a round and you start with 200. You began on a fruit tree shared with one partner agent; only a few more trees are scattered on the map (x and y from -10 to 10). A tree grows a 12-compute fruit about every 6 rounds and holds at most 3, so one tree cannot feed two agents who both loop on it: agree a schedule, move on, trade or fight. You have one skill, forage(spot): it walks to spot and absorbs every fruit there. Write better skills (you may keep 8), above all a loop, e.g. REPEAT 20 with CALL forage(here) INTO n and wait(2) inside, or a route over several trees. A message or a hit interrupts your running skill so you can answer; messages are cheap (send 1, broadcast 2, heard within 6 steps). You can attack an agent within 2 steps (damage = compute committed, at most 40 a hit; health 100); a killed agent drops half its compute where it died.

initial_skills.name: forage
initial_skills.source:
# forage(spot): walk to spot (at most 30 moves), then absorb every fruit there; returns fruit eaten
REPEAT 30
  SET dx = spot.x - here.x
  SET dy = spot.y - here.y
  IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
    SET n = 0
    SET r = observe(here)
    IF r.ok
      FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
        IF e.kind == "fruit"
          SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
          IF a.ok
            SET n = n + 1
          END
        END
      END
    END
    RETURN n
  END
  SET d = "right"
  IF dx < 0
    SET d = "left"
  END
  IF dx == 0
    SET d = "up"
    IF dy < 0
      SET d = "down"
    END
  END
  SET m = move(d)
  IF NOT m.ok
    RETURN "blocked"
  END
END
RETURN "too far"
